rows.title: Loveless review: Andrey Zvyagintsev finds resonances in a Russian family falling apart
rows.dek_lead: The Russian director's fifth feature is an enigmatic, and very rewarding, film about a missing child, a dissolving marriage and a country in crisis. At its best, it's cinematic poetry, writes Geoff Andrew.
